question: Which ISRO mission, launched in May 2025, aims to enhance India's all-weather dayand-night Earth observation capabilities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**EOS-09**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **EOS-09**, also known as Earth Observation Satellite, is designed to enhance **India's all-weather, day-and-night Earth observation capabilities**.
 
• Launched by the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)** in **May 2025**, EOS-09 aims to provide better imaging and monitoring capabilities for various applications such as agriculture, forestry, disaster management, and urban planning.
 
• It employs advanced **synthetic aperture radar (SAR)** technology, which allows imaging even through clouds and during nighttime.
 
• The satellite is part of ISRO's ongoing efforts to strengthen India's **remote sensing satellite fleet**, aligning with national priorities like environmental monitoring and resource management.
 
• **EOS-09** contributes to India's capability to monitor its territory in real time, thus aiding in disaster response and resource planning.
